title: Covington & Burling Distinguished Visitor and Lecturer on Law
bio: Dale Cendali is a partner in Kirkland & Ellis LLP’s New York office and chairs Kirkland’s Copyright, Trademark, Internet and Advertising Practice Group. She is a nationally recognized leader in the field of intellectual property litigation, having successfully litigated and tried numerous high-profile cases, causing her to be named an “Icon of IP” by IP360.
